claim: On 3 of the 6 graded tasks in the corpus, claude-sonnet-4-6 achieves the same medal tier as claude-opus-4-7 at 2-3× lower cost.
scope: Six tasks across 5 different task families (sentiment, tabular, satellite, document, FGVC, text-classification). Plausibly extends to other 'easy' tasks where current SOTA is well-documented and the data fits in <100MB.
limitations: Only 1 run per (task, model) pair for most tasks. We cannot rule out variance.

'Easy' vs 'hard' is observed post-hoc, not predicted. We do not yet have a feature that lets us decide a priori which side a new task will land on. Best current proxy: data size + modality + whether the leaderboard top is well above bronze threshold.
